title: Encrypted DNS Host Resolver Installation Planning Work Item
summary: Add deterministic host resolver installation plans for encrypted DNS inputs without calling platform resolver APIs.
planned_changes:
- Add host resolver installation status and plan models.
- Add a planner that composes RFC 9461 service-binding, RFC 9463 discovery, and RFC 9464 provisioning client plans with encrypted DNS session attempts.
- Preserve cleartext fallback resolver candidates and split-tunnel internal domains.
- Return non-installable blocked plans for explicit Do53 preference and untrusted NULL-authenticated provisioning.
- Add focused positive and negative tests plus canonical xrefs.
- Update the encrypted DNS gap ledger to separate local installation planning from OS resolver mutation.
verification_plan: Run the DNS project build, focused host resolver installation planner tests, core SpecTrace validation, generated QUIC requirement coverage triage, and diff hygiene before commit.
completion_notes: The DNS package now has a trace-owned platform-adapter input for host resolver installation.
